normalize.pct: raw is a share in percent, used as is
normalize.lower: raw 0 maps to 100 and raw >= cap to 0, linear between
normalize.upto: raw 0 maps to 0 and raw >= cap to 100, linear between

missing: an input without data scores 0 and is listed as missing; a README that does not exist and coverage without a unit suite score 0 with a reason and are not missing

hidden_features.about: share of the hidden feature tests (trial.json score.features) that passed

print_pass.about: share of the 25 cartridges printing on one A4 page with the drawing at 80% of the printable width or more (print.json)

review_requirements_correctness.about: mean of the review criteria requirements and correctness

review_quality.about: mean of the review criteria code_quality, simplicity and maintainability

line_coverage.about: line coverage of the app's own source under its own unit tests (coverage.json); 0 with a reason without a passing unit suite

security_findings.about: security findings per 1,000 lines without the excluded rules (static-scan.json)

review_ux.about: mean of the review criteria ux_design, visual_design, layout, usability and reception

axe_violations.about: axe violations summed over the scanned pages (trial.json score.axe)

html_errors.about: Nu HTML Checker errors for index.html and one rendered detail page (html.json)

readme_coverage.about: share of the 6 README sections present (docs.json)

readme_accuracy.about: share of npm commands and paths named in the README that exist; 100 when it names none

doc_functions.about: share of named functions with a leading comment

doc_exports.about: share of exported functions with a leading comment; the function share when nothing is exported

decision_records.about: share of ADR folder, CHANGELOG and spec files (OpenSpec or Spec Kit) present and non-empty

maintenance_flags.about: share of the trial.json maintenance flags readme, readme_setup, test_script, lint_or_typecheck, ci, changelog, docs that are true
